title: Security at Fonderie
lede: Fonderie is the audited standard for SaaS infrastructure. It's open source (MIT), runs in your own process against your own database, and ships security into the defaults — so the apps built on it are secure by construction. Here's how it's built, released, and secured.

items.title: Authentication done right
items.text: bcrypt password hashing, TOTP multi-factor auth with backup codes, and sessions revoked on password change.

items.title: Encrypted secrets
items.text: MFA/TOTP secrets encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM). Signing secrets are validated fail-closed — a weak or missing secret stops the app from booting.

items.title: Least-privilege access
items.text: Workspace-scoped role-based access control with tenant-isolated, parameterized queries. No cross-tenant leakage.

items.title: Abuse protection
items.text: Rate limiting is on by default in front of login, registration, password reset, and MFA.

items.title: Tamper-evident audit trail
items.text: Every event carries a keyed HMAC, so altered or forged history is detectable.

items.title: Hardened transport
items.text: HSTS and secure-by-default response headers; Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite cookies in production.

items.title: Self-hosted by design
items.text: Fonderie runs in your process against your database. We don't host or hold your end-users' data.

items.title: Export & erasure built in
items.text: Per-user data export (Subject Access Request) and configurable data retention and erasure ship in the box.

items.title: No lock-in
items.text: MIT-licensed, plain TypeScript. Take one brick or the whole set. What you build is yours.

items.title: Reviewed, protected mainline
items.text: Every change goes through a pull request with passing CI on a protected main branch; security-sensitive paths are routed to reviewers via CODEOWNERS.

items.title: Continuous vulnerability checks
items.text: CI fails the build on high-severity advisories in shipped dependencies.

items.title: Signed releases
items.text: Packages publish over OIDC Trusted Publishing with SLSA provenance — no long-lived tokens.

items.title: Responsible disclosure
items.text: Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's security advisories. We acknowledge, assess, and fix in the open.

items.title: SOC 2
items.text: Fonderie is not SOC 2 certified. We've implemented the technical controls a SOC 2 examines — access control, encryption, audit logging, change management — and documented our security policies. Formal certification is on our roadmap.

items.title: Verifiable by default
items.text: Our security posture isn't a marketing claim — it's in the open. Read the source and our security policy, and check it yourself.
